_: Counter attendants (workstream Q, design/godot-dialogue.md 'Attendants'). One unique person behind each counter. wing/years: where they exist (a store closed that year has none). skin: an npc/skins.json id the wing's pack ships (Ch*/Remy); Steven may swap. area: [x0, z0, x1, z1] world metres behind the counter they wander in; face: the direction they stand facing (toward the shop floor); talk_at: where the interactable stands (the shop side of the counter, so the 1.6 m reach works across it). name and dialogue are PLACEHOLDERs until Steven writes them. redemption: true = the redemption screen (session R) opens first when it exists. INT (Demo 49): "spots" (workstream GI) are places only; story.gd reads "attendants" and ignores "spots".
